rules.title: Health insurance open enrollment is open
rules.body: Marketplace open enrollment runs November 1 to January 15 in HealthCare.gov states (state sites vary). Enroll by December 15 for coverage that starts January 1.

evidence.label: HealthCare.gov
evidence.citation: HealthCare.gov dates and deadlines, as of 2026-09

rules.title: Claim the Child Tax Credit when you file
rules.body: The Child Tax Credit is worth up to $2,200 per qualifying child under 17 for the 2026 tax year, up to $1,700 of it refundable. It phases out above $200,000 of income for single filers ($400,000 joint).

evidence.label: IRS
evidence.citation: IRS Child Tax Credit guidance, as of 2026-09

rules.title: High income? The Child Tax Credit may still apply
rules.body: The credit doesn't cut off at a band edge: it phases out $50 per $1,000 above $200,000 of income for single filers ($400,000 joint), so many joint filers above $200,000 keep the full $2,200 per child under 17.

evidence.label: IRS
evidence.citation: IRS Child Tax Credit guidance, as of 2026-09

rules.title: Spend your health FSA before year end
rules.body: Health FSA balances usually don't roll over: most plans require spending by December 31, though some allow a limited carryover or grace period — check yours and plan glasses or elective care early.

evidence.label: IRS
evidence.citation: IRS health FSA rules (Publication 969), as of 2026-09
